sheqx.name: SHEQX®
sheqx.headline: SHEQ compliance that closes actions, not just spreadsheets.
sheqx.lede: SHEQX® aggregates safety, health, environment, and quality data into one auditable platform — giving you the visibility to prevent incidents, close non-conformances, and sustain ISO certification without the administrative drag.

challenges.title: Incidents tracked in email
challenges.body: Safety events get logged then forgotten. No closure, no pattern analysis, no learning.

challenges.title: ISO audits reveal surprises
challenges.body: Compliance gaps stay invisible until an external audit makes them official findings with deadlines attached.

challenges.title: Permits expire unnoticed
challenges.body: Legal appointments, MSDSs, and operational permits lapse because nobody owns the expiry calendar.

challenges.title: Actions with no accountability
challenges.body: Corrective actions raised, assigned, then orphaned. Months later, the same issue recurs.

msx.name: MSX®
msx.headline: One management system. Multiple standards. Less duplicated effort.
msx.lede: MSX® merges your governance, risk, compliance, and operational systems into one common framework — eliminating conflicting responsibilities, removing duplicated effort, and giving leadership real-time visibility across all business activities.

challenges.title: Multiple systems, multiple truths
challenges.body: ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001 managed in separate tools. The same data entered three times, never reconciled.

challenges.title: Improvement programmes disconnected from risk
challenges.body: Continual improvement initiatives tracked in isolation — no link to the risks they are supposed to address.

challenges.title: Board reporting takes weeks
challenges.body: Management performance data lives across departments, systems, and spreadsheets. Consolidation consumes more resource than the analysis.

challenges.title: Certification gaps only surface at audit time
challenges.body: Without continuous monitoring across all ISO requirements, gaps accumulate silently between certification cycles.

msxcyber.name: MSXCyber®
msxcyber.headline: ISO 27001 compliance without the spreadsheet chaos.
msxcyber.lede: MSXCyber® delivers a complete Information Security Management System aligned to ISO 27001:2022 — with governance, risk management, and audit-ready evidence built in from day one. Data breaches now carry material financial, regulatory and operational consequences — structured ISMS governance is no longer optional.

challenges.title: ISO 27001 gaps only found at audit
challenges.body: Without continuous monitoring, control weaknesses accumulate quietly between certification reviews.

challenges.title: Asset inventories in spreadsheets
challenges.body: Assets undocumented, risks unassessed. One security incident reveals just how fragile the inventory actually is.

challenges.title: No structured incident response
challenges.body: When a breach occurs, the response is improvised. Regulatory disclosure obligations are missed. Costs escalate.

challenges.title: GDPR and POPIA obligations untracked
challenges.body: Data protection compliance managed through email threads — no evidence trail, no audit readiness.

erm.name: Enterprise Risk Management
erm.headline: Risk managed at enterprise scale, not spreadsheet scale.
erm.lede: A structured, auditable approach to enterprise, operational, and project risk — aligned to ISO 31000 and COSO ERM — with board-level dashboards, risk appetite monitoring, and corrective action tracking built in.

challenges.title: Risk registers nobody maintains
challenges.body: Annual reviews produce impressive registers that are outdated before they are presented. Residual risk is never re-assessed.

challenges.title: Risk appetite defined, but not enforced
challenges.body: The board sets appetite thresholds. Operational decisions ignore them. There is no mechanism to detect or escalate breaches.

challenges.title: KRIs reported in isolation
challenges.body: Key risk indicators tracked separately from the risks they monitor. Early warning signals go unnoticed until they become incidents.

challenges.title: Risk and assurance disconnected
challenges.body: The audit plan bears no relationship to the risk register. High-risk areas go unaudited. Low-risk areas receive excess coverage.

integrated-assurance.name: Integrated Assurance
integrated-assurance.headline: One audit plan. Four lines of defence. Zero gaps.
integrated-assurance.lede: Coordinate internal audit and combined assurance across your organisation — linked directly to risks, controls, and corrective actions — so every line of defence operates from the same picture of what needs assurance.

challenges.title: Audit findings that do not close risks
challenges.body: Internal audit operates independently from the risk register. Findings are raised, management responds, risks stay open.

challenges.title: Combined assurance maps in PowerPoint
challenges.body: Outdated the moment they are presented. Nobody knows who is providing assurance over which risks until the board asks.

challenges.title: Coverage gaps and duplication
challenges.body: High-risk areas receive no audit attention. Low-risk areas audited three times by different lines. Nobody has a consolidated view.

challenges.title: Reactive audit planning
challenges.body: Annual plans built from intuition and last year's plan, not from the current risk landscape. Emerging risks go unaudited.

envirx.name: ENVIRX®
envirx.headline: Environmental compliance you can demonstrate, not just claim.
envirx.lede: ENVIRX® captures, tracks, and reports environmental performance data — from waste and water to air quality and energy consumption — in a single auditable system aligned to ISO 14001 and local environmental legislation.

challenges.title: Monitoring data scattered across sites
challenges.body: Each facility tracks environmental data differently. Consolidated reporting requires weeks of manual reconciliation.

challenges.title: Regulatory inspections reveal unrecorded incidents
challenges.body: Environmental events that were informally dealt with on-site become formal non-compliances when an inspector asks for the evidence.

challenges.title: Targets set but not monitored
challenges.body: Reduction commitments made to stakeholders and regulators. Progress is invisible until the annual sustainability report.

challenges.title: Legal requirements change faster than compliance registers
challenges.body: Environmental legislation is updated continuously. Manual tracking cannot keep pace.

esg.name: ESG
esg.headline: ESG reporting that survives investor scrutiny.
esg.lede: Collect, manage, and report ESG data in a structured, auditable way — aligned to GRI, IFRS S1/S2, and CDP — so your sustainability disclosures are backed by evidence, not just intention.

challenges.title: Disclosures built on unverifiable data
challenges.body: ESG reports assembled from manually collected spreadsheets. Investors and auditors increasingly ask for evidence. Evidence is not there.

challenges.title: Questionnaires that take weeks to complete
challenges.body: Investor ESG questionnaires arrive and the search begins. Data is scattered, definitions differ by site, nobody owns the numbers.

challenges.title: Targets without audit trails
challenges.body: Net-zero commitments and social targets made publicly. Progress tracked informally. Assurance providers have nothing to work with.

challenges.title: Regulatory disclosure obligations missed
challenges.body: IFRS S1 and S2 requirements are expanding. Organisations without structured ESG data collection cannot comply in time.

compliance-hub.name: XGRC® Compliance Hub
compliance-hub.headline: Your supply chain's compliance posture, visible in real time.
compliance-hub.lede: Structured onboarding, vetting, and ongoing compliance management for suppliers, contractors, and third parties — with automated document expiry tracking, risk scoring, and compliance dashboards that give you a live view of your entire supply chain.

challenges.title: Certificates expire without warning
challenges.body: Supplier documents managed through email. Nobody owns the expiry calendar. A non-compliant contractor arrives on site.

challenges.title: Onboarding takes weeks
challenges.body: Manual verification, back-and-forth emails, documents in different formats. High-risk contractors cleared faster than low-risk ones because nobody applied the same standard.

challenges.title: No real-time supply chain view
challenges.body: You cannot answer the question "which of our active contractors are currently compliant?" without running a spreadsheet exercise.

challenges.title: Incidents reveal undiscovered gaps
challenges.body: A site incident exposes a contractor whose safety certification lapsed three months ago. Nobody noticed.

xlogic.name: XLOGIC®
xlogic.headline: Policies that work. Controls that are actually enforced.
xlogic.lede: XLOGIC® converts governance frameworks, policies, and controls into structured, enforceable workflows — so compliance is built into how work gets done, not bolted on afterwards through audits.

challenges.title: Policies approved and filed, never operationalised
challenges.body: Documents are published. Employees are notified. Controls are never implemented. The gap between policy and practice grows with every update.

challenges.title: Frameworks defined at board level, disconnected from operations
challenges.body: Governance structures documented in reports. Day-to-day operations run on institutional knowledge, habit, and workarounds.

challenges.title: Evidence collected reactively
challenges.body: Compliance evidence gathered when an audit is announced, not continuously as work is performed. Evidence quality reflects urgency, not accuracy.

challenges.title: Controls that exist on paper only
challenges.body: Internal audit reveals controls that are documented but not operating effectively. Management responses are familiar words.

maia.name: MAIA®
maia.headline: The intelligence of governance — governed, audited, accountable.
maia.lede: MAIA® is governed AI for GRC, embedded within XGRC® to help decision-makers interact with governance records, risks, policies, and compliance data. Faster insight. Better decisions. Full auditability — through controlled, audited AI integrations with a complete interaction audit trail.

challenges.title: Answers take days, not minutes
challenges.body: A board member asks about residual risk in a business unit. The risk manager spends two days compiling a response from multiple systems.

challenges.title: Governance records exist but are inaccessible
challenges.body: Policies, risk registers, audit findings, and compliance records accumulated over years. Too dense, too fragmented for rapid insight generation.

challenges.title: AI tools that create new governance risk
challenges.body: Generic AI tools may operate outside the governance, permission and audit controls required for regulated GRC decisions. Using them for governance decisions creates risk instead of reducing it.

challenges.title: Strategic decisions disconnected from operational risk data
challenges.body: Leadership makes decisions without a live view of the risk and compliance posture. The data exists. Nobody can access it fast enough to matter.

libryo.name: Libryo
libryo.headline: Legal obligations, translated into action — for every site, every jurisdiction.
libryo.lede: Libryo turns dense, constantly-changing EHS legislation into clear, site-specific compliance obligations. XGRC® partners with Libryo to embed jurisdiction-specific regulatory intelligence directly into your legal register, so obligations, tasks, and evidence live on the same platform as the rest of your governance and risk data.

challenges.title: Legal registers built and maintained by hand
challenges.body: Legislation is tracked in spreadsheets by whoever has time. Updates depend on someone noticing a change in the Government Gazette.

challenges.title: Multi-site, multi-jurisdiction sprawl
challenges.body: Every site operates under a different mix of national, provincial, and local regulation. No single view of what applies where.

challenges.title: Regulatory changes discovered too late
challenges.body: A law changes; the business finds out at the next audit, or after an inspector does. There is no early-warning mechanism.

challenges.title: Obligations identified, but not actioned
challenges.body: Legal registers list what must be done. They rarely track who owns it, whether it was done, or what evidence proves it.

hakware.name: Hakware
hakware.headline: Continuous, AI-driven penetration testing that keeps you one step ahead.
hakware.lede: Hakware is an AI-powered security management platform that tests your environment the way an attacker would — continuously, not once a year. XGRC® partners with Hakware to bring offensive security testing, unified vulnerability visibility, and dark web monitoring into the same governed environment as your ISMS.

challenges.title: Penetration tests happen once a year
challenges.body: Annual pentests produce a point-in-time report. New vulnerabilities in the eleven months between tests go undetected.

challenges.title: Security data scattered across tools
challenges.body: Firewalls, endpoints, cloud environments, and Microsoft 365 each report separately. No single view of actual exposure.

challenges.title: Manual triage misses what matters
challenges.body: Security teams are buried in alerts. Human error and alert fatigue mean genuine vulnerabilities slip through.

challenges.title: Breaches discovered from the outside
challenges.body: Leaked credentials and exposed data surface on the dark web long before anyone internally notices the exposure.

xrm.name: XRM
xrm.headline: Pipeline discipline, not pipeline guesswork.
xrm.lede: XRM gives your sales team one governed system to qualify leads, progress opportunities, generate quotes and close deals, with the approval workflows, audit trail and real-time visibility leadership actually needs. Built and run on the same ISO/IEC 27001:2022-certified XGRC® infrastructure as the rest of the platform, not a bolted-on CRM that quietly becomes another unmanaged spreadsheet.

challenges.title: Leads and real deals blur together
challenges.body: Unqualified interest sits in the same list as live opportunities, so nobody can tell what is genuine pipeline and what is noise.

challenges.title: Deals move with no accountability
challenges.body: Reps shift opportunities between stages unchecked, discounts get approved in a hallway conversation, and forecasts are guesses dressed up as numbers.

challenges.title: Quotes leave the building unmanaged
challenges.body: Pricing goes out over email, versions get lost, and nobody can say with confidence which quote the customer actually accepted.

challenges.title: Leadership has no real-time view
challenges.body: Pipeline health, at-risk deals and quota attainment live in a spreadsheet someone updates once a week, if that.
